title: Sales and Leases
description: Sales and Leases of Goods under UCC Articles 1, 2 and 2A, Weeks 1–14 (Sepinuck, Chapters 1–7, 9 and 11). Covers which law governs, formation and the battle of the forms, the statute of frauds, warranties and disclaimers, gap fillers, delivery and risk of loss, the parol evidence rule, assignment and delegation, repudiation, excuse, buyer's and seller's remedies, rejection, cure and revocation, privity, and leases under Article 2A.

documents.subject: sales-and-leases
documents.title: Sales and Leases Outline
documents.description: Condensed outline of Weeks 1–14 for the final exam. 35 sections. Sections I–XVI cover Weeks 1–8: the UCC and governing law, formation and § 2-207, the statute of frauds and unconscionability, good faith and modification, express and implied warranties, quantity and price, delivery and risk of loss, disclaimers, remedy limits, the parol evidence rule, assignment, termination, insecurity and repudiation, and excuse. Sections XVII–XXXV follow the syllabus through Week 14: buyer's remedies, rejection, cure, acceptance and revocation, privity, seller's remedies, Article 2A leases and finance leases, and final-exam checklists, with every assigned problem worked. Case boxes mark main, note, and cited-only cases with their casebook pages and class slides. Slides on file end at Week 8, so later sections rest on the casebook and statutes.

documents.subject: sales-and-leases
documents.title: Sales and Leases Bar Questions
documents.description: 444 bar-style multiple-choice questions on Weeks 1–14: the rules, cases, and assigned problems in the outline, from which law governs and the battle of the forms through warranties, risk of loss, disclaimers, buyer's and seller's remedies, privity, and leases under Article 2A. Each question sets out new facts, and every answer choice has its own explanation. Variations change one fact to test whether the result changes. Filter by topic, shuffle the questions or answers, retry the ones you missed, and use the coverage map to find the questions for any outline item.

documents.subject: sales-and-leases
documents.title: Sales and Leases Practice Exams
documents.description: 58 cumulative practice exams (870 questions) for the final, covering all of Weeks 1–14 and all 35 sections of the course outline, from which law governs and the battle of the forms through warranties, risk of loss, buyer's and seller's remedies, privity, and leases under Article 2A. Each exam follows Professor Richardson's sample-exam format: 15 stand-alone, five-choice questions that mix rule questions (“Which of the following is NOT…”) with short hypos asking who wins and why, plus “None of the above” and “All of the above” choices that are sometimes the answer. Every exam samples the whole course, and about 40% of the questions come from the Weeks 8–14 remedies and lease units, including integrated hypos and damages calculations. Every choice has its own explanation. Use Study mode to check answers as you go, or Exam mode to grade a full exam, and pick a topic to drill one outline section by week.

documents.subject: sales-and-leases
documents.title: Sales and Leases Statutory Supplement
documents.description: Every UCC section the Weeks 1-14 outline and the practice sets cite (182 sections from Articles 1, 2, 2A, and 9), from Selected Commercial Statutes, 2026 edition, with the Official Comments. Section text is summarized in the statute's own key words and each comment is condensed; comments the outline or the practice questions rely on are marked. Search by word, phrase, or cite (type 2-207 to go straight there), filter by any of the outline's first 34 sections, follow cross-references between sections, and open or close all the comments at once.
